description: Mark a comment thread resolved (or reopen it with resolved: false) after you have addressed it. The pin turns grey and drops out of the open list for everyone; nothing is deleted. Returns { ok, page_id, thread_id, resolved }. Fails with thread_not_found if the id is not an open-or-resolved thread on that page.

page_id.description: The page id: the `id` field from publish_page or list_pages (also the last path segment of the page URL, …/docs/<page_id>). Only pages in the connected maker's space are visible.

resolved.description: Default true. false reopens the thread.

name: resolve_comment
title: Resolve a comment thread
